objectives.en: I can use -ing after enjoy, finish, mind, avoid and suggest.

objectives.en: I can use -ing after prepositions (good at cooking, interested in learning) and both forms after like, love and hate.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש ב-ing אחרי מילות יחס (good at cooking, interested in learning) ובשתי הצורות אחרי like, ‏love ו-hate.

warmup.en: Finish these two sentences about yourself: I really enjoy... / This year I want... Did you use the same verb form after enjoy and want?
warmup.he: השלימו על עצמכם את שני המשפטים: I really enjoy... / This year I want... האם השתמשתם באותה צורת פועל אחרי enjoy ואחרי want?

explanation.en: Look: I enjoy cooking. I want to cook more. She's good at cooking. When one verb follows another, the first verb decides the form of the second: -ing (cooking) or to + base verb (to cook). No simple rule covers every verb, so learn each verb with its pattern, as one chunk: enjoy doing, want to do.
explanation.he: שימו לב: I enjoy cooking. ‏I want to cook more. ‏She's good at cooking. כשפועל אחד בא אחרי פועל אחר, הפועל הראשון קובע את הצורה של השני: ing ‏(cooking) או to + פועל בסיס (to cook). אין כלל פשוט שמתאים לכל הפעלים, ולכן כדאי ללמוד כל פועל יחד עם הדפוס שלו, כצירוף אחד: enjoy doing, want to do.

rows: enjoy: I enjoy reading on the train.
want: I want to read more.
decide: We decided to stay at home.
mind: Do you mind waiting a minute?
hope: I hope to see you soon.
avoid: I avoid driving in the rush hour.
plan: They're planning to move to Haifa.
suggest: Omer suggested taking a taxi.
also: keep, practise, can't stand, give up
also: would like, learn, agree, afford, manage

explanation.en: After a preposition (in, at, about, of, for, without, before, after...), always use -ing: I'm interested in learning Japanese. She's good at drawing. Thanks for coming. Don't leave without saying goodbye.
explanation.he: אחרי מילת יחס (in, at, about, of, for, without, before, after...) תמיד בא ing: I'm interested in learning Japanese. ‏She's good at drawing. ‏Thanks for coming. ‏Don't leave without saying goodbye.

explanation.en: like, love and hate can take both forms with almost no change in meaning: I love dancing / I love to dance. But would like, would love and would hate take only to: I'd like to dance (not *I'd like dancing).
explanation.he: אחרי like, ‏love ו-hate אפשר להשתמש בשתי הצורות, כמעט בלי הבדל במשמעות: I love dancing / I love to dance. אבל אחרי would like, ‏would love ו-would hate בא רק to: I'd like to dance (ולא I'd like dancing).

explanation.en: The to trap: in look forward to, to is a preposition, so -ing follows: I'm looking forward to seeing you (not *to see you). And watch out for: *I enjoy to cook → I enjoy cooking; *She suggested to go → She suggested going; *I want going → I want to go.
explanation.he: מלכודת ה-to: בצירוף look forward to, ה-to היא מילת יחס, ולכן אחריה בא ing: I'm looking forward to seeing you (ולא to see you). והיזהרו גם מאלה: כותבים I enjoy cooking ולא I enjoy to cook; ‏She suggested going ולא She suggested to go; ‏I want to go ולא I want going.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew /ŋ/ is not a separate sound (it only appears before g or k), so -ing can come out as 'in' or 'ing-g'. In English, -ing ends in /ŋ/ alone, with no g after it: cooking /ˈkʊkɪŋ/, enjoy dancing.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית /ŋ/ אינו צליל עצמאי (הוא מופיע רק לפני g או k), ולכן ing עלול לצאת "אין" או "אינג-ג". באנגלית ing מסתיים ב-/ŋ/ בלבד, בלי g אחריו: cooking /ˈkʊkɪŋ/, ‏enjoy dancing.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew there is one 'u' vowel, so look /lʊk/ and good /ɡʊd/ can come out long, like 'Luke'. Keep them short and relaxed: look forward to, good at.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית יש תנועת "u" אחת, ולכן look /lʊk/ ו-good /ɡʊd/ עלולים לצאת ארוכים, כמו "לוּוּק". אמרו אותם קצרים ורפויים: look forward to, ‏good at.

prompt.en: Which pattern does each verb take?

explanation.en: -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, mind, practise. to + verb: want, decide, hope, plan, need, afford. Learn them as chunks: enjoy doing, want to do.
explanation.he: ing: ‏enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, mind, practise. ‏to + פועל: want, decide, hope, plan, need, afford. כדאי ללמוד אותם כצירופים: enjoy doing, want to do.

exercises.title: Email: Before my exchange trip
exercises.passage:
Dear Mr and Mrs Clarke,

My name is Noa, and I'm the student from Israel who is going to stay with you in July. I'm really looking forward to meeting you!

Here is a little about me. I'm seventeen and I live in Be'er Sheva with my parents and my younger brother. I enjoy cooking, and I'm quite good at making Israeli food, so I'd love to cook dinner for you one evening. I also like going to the gym, and I'm planning to keep training during my stay. I'm not very good at getting up early, but I promise to try!

I don't eat meat, but please don't worry about cooking special meals for me. I'm happy to eat vegetables and pasta.

Another Israeli student, Amir, is staying with a family on your street, and we've decided to practise our English together. I hope you don't mind him visiting sometimes in the afternoon.

Thank you for agreeing to have me. I can't wait to see England!

Best wishes,
Noa

2.en: Noa wants to cook – Amir is not part of that plan.
2.he: נועה רוצה לבשל, אבל אמיר לא חלק מהתוכנית הזאת.

explanation.en: 'We've decided to practise our English together.' decide + to.
explanation.he: בטקסט: We've decided to practise our English together. ‏decide + to.

questions.text: Noa is planning to keep ___ during her stay.
answers: training
going to the gym

feedback.en: keep is followed by -ing: keep training.
feedback.he: אחרי keep בא ing: ‏keep training.

feedback.en: keep is followed by -ing: keep training.
feedback.he: אחרי keep בא ing: ‏keep training.

explanation.en: 'I'm planning to keep training during my stay.' plan + to, then keep + -ing.
explanation.he: בטקסט: I'm planning to keep training during my stay. ‏plan + to, ואחר כך keep + ing.

questions.statement: Noa wants the family to cook special meals for her.

explanation.en: 'Please don't worry about cooking special meals for me.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: Please don't worry about cooking special meals for me.

explanation.en: The email is full of verb patterns: looking forward to meeting, enjoy cooking, good at making, planning to keep training, decided to practise.
explanation.he: המייל מלא בדפוסי פעלים: looking forward to meeting, ‏enjoy cooking, ‏good at making, ‏planning to keep training, ‏decided to practise.

exercises.audio_text: I don't mind waiting, but I can't afford to miss the last bus.
answers: I don't mind waiting, but I can't afford to miss the last bus.

explanation.en: mind + -ing (waiting); afford + to (to miss).
explanation.he: אחרי mind בא ing ‏(waiting), ואחרי afford בא to ‏(to miss).

prompt.en: You're ending a message to a friend you'll see soon. Say it out loud.
prompt.he: אתם מסיימים הודעה לחבר שתפגשו בקרוב. אמרו אותה בקול.

exercises.target: I'm really looking forward to seeing you!

focus.en: End -ing with /ŋ/ and no g: looking /ˈlʊkɪŋ/, seeing /ˈsiːɪŋ/. Keep look short: /lʊk/, not 'Luke'.
focus.he: סיימו את ing ב-/ŋ/ בלי g: looking /ˈlʊkɪŋ/, ‏seeing /ˈsiːɪŋ/. ואמרו את look קצר: /lʊk/, לא "לוּוּק".

explanation.en: A very common way to end a friendly message or email. Remember: look forward to + -ing.
explanation.he: דרך נפוצה מאוד לסיים הודעה או מייל ידידותיים. זכרו: look forward to + ing.

prompt.en: Write an email to someone you are going to live with.
prompt.he: כתבו מייל למישהו שאתם עומדים לגור איתו.

task.en: Write an email (80-120 words) to a host family or a new flatmate before you meet. Say what you enjoy doing, what you're good at, what you're planning or hoping to do during your stay, and one thing you'd like to do together. Use at least three verbs + -ing, three verbs + to, and one preposition + -ing.
task.he: כתבו מייל (80-120 מילים) למשפחה מארחת או לשותף/ה חדש/ה לדירה לפני שאתם נפגשים. ספרו מה אתם נהנים לעשות, במה אתם טובים, מה אתם מתכננים או מקווים לעשות בתקופה הזאת, ודבר אחד שהייתם רוצים לעשות ביחד. השתמשו לפחות בשלושה פעלים + ing, שלושה פעלים + to, ומילת יחס אחת + ing.

exercises.model_answer:
Hi Daniel,

I'm Omer, your new flatmate! I've just finished packing, and I'm really looking forward to meeting you next week. A little about me: I'm studying computer science, and I enjoy playing football and cooking. I'm not very good at cleaning, but I promise to do my share! I'm planning to join a gym near the flat, and I hope to find a cheap place for lunch too. I'd love to go for a run with you sometimes – I don't mind getting up early. Also, I need to buy a desk, so if you know a good shop, let me know.

See you soon!
Omer

checklist.en: I used at least three verbs + -ing (enjoy, mind, finish, avoid, suggest, practise...).
checklist.he: השתמשתי לפחות בשלושה פעלים + ing ‏(enjoy, mind, finish, avoid, suggest, practise...).

checklist.en: I used at least three verbs + to (want, plan, hope, decide, need, would like...).
checklist.he: השתמשתי לפחות בשלושה פעלים + to ‏(want, plan, hope, decide, need, would like...).

checklist.en: After prepositions (at, in, about, for, forward to), I used -ing.
checklist.he: אחרי מילות יחס (at, in, about, for, forward to) השתמשתי ב-ing.

checklist.en: I used would like / would love + to (I'd like to..., not *I'd like doing).
checklist.he: אחרי would like / would love השתמשתי ב-to (I'd like to... ולא I'd like doing).

explanation.en: Introducing yourself is full of these patterns: what you enjoy doing, what you want to do and what you are good at doing.
explanation.he: בהיכרות עצמית יש הרבה דפוסים כאלה: מה אתם נהנים לעשות (enjoy doing), מה אתם רוצים לעשות (want to do) ובמה אתם טובים (good at doing).

key_points.en: Verb + -ing: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, practise, keep. Verb + to: want, decide, hope, plan, need, afford, would like.
key_points.he: פועל + ing: ‏enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, practise, keep. פועל + to: ‏want, decide, hope, plan, need, afford, would like.

key_points.en: After a preposition, always -ing: good at cooking, interested in learning, thanks for coming.
key_points.he: אחרי מילת יחס תמיד ing: ‏good at cooking, interested in learning, thanks for coming.

key_points.en: like / love / hate + either form; would like / would love + to only.
key_points.he: אחרי like / love / hate אפשר את שתי הצורות; אחרי would like / would love רק to.

key_points.en: Watch the to trap: look forward to seeing (to is a preposition).
key_points.he: היזהרו ממלכודת ה-to: ‏look forward to seeing (ה-to היא מילת יחס).

key_points.en: suggest + -ing: She suggested going (not *suggested to go).
key_points.he: suggest + ing: ‏She suggested going (ולא suggested to go).
